context: Planning call for a trade show booth. Dan is the sales lead. Facts: booth size 12 square metres, show dates 14 to 16 October, booth budget $18,000, the lead scanner licence costs $600.

lines.text: Hello all, Ines, Ravi and Tomas, thanks for joining.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Hi Dan. Let us start with the money. Ravi has the latest numbers.

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: The booth quote came back at twenty four thousand dollars, and that is more than we planned.
That is higher than our budget, I will note it.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Ravi, did you send the signed contract to the printer yet?

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: Not yet, I will do it after this call.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: I can reduce the design cost if we drop the second banner.
Let us see the saving before we decide.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Dan, who will staff the booth on the first day?
I would put two people from sales on the first day.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: Ravi, can you check the power sockets in the hall plan?

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: Sure, I have the plan open.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: We decided last week that the lead scanner is a must, and it costs six hundred dollars.
Agreed, leads matter most at a show.

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: Tomas, are you free on Friday to review the stand design?

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: One more thing, the show dates are the fourteenth to the sixteenth, so we need the flights this week.
